name: Verify Built Reels
description: Runs the reel conformance verifier over the timelines build_reels placed, grading them against the plan they were built from, and fails the run on any error finding.

inputs.name: project_folder
inputs.description: Absolute path to the project. Whitelisted global injected by gather_step_inputs. The conformance report is written under its pipeline_output/review/.

inputs.name: reel_build
inputs.description: The build's own record of what was placed, carried by the edge from build_reels: which timelines, which plan, and into which Resolve project and master timeline. Read rather than re-derived - a verifier that recomputes the plan or the binding can grade against a different answer than the one the build wrote, which is how a caption grouping was re-derived a day later and graded against.

inputs.name: timeline_transcript
inputs.description: The master timeline's speech. The verifier grades placed speech against it, so it is as hard an input here as it is for the build. NO STEP PRODUCES IT; see step_7_01_build_reels.

outputs.name: reel_verification
outputs.description: The record of a PASS: which plan was graded, which timelines, and into which Resolve project. A failure raises rather than returning, so this key existing means the reels conformed.

metadata.author: prajwal
metadata.notes: Belongs to library/processes/reels, not to edit_video.
